raw_response:
I've been farming this rented land for 35 years. I'm 68 now, and my legs aren't what they used to be, but I still know every corner of these 16 mu. My family has 7 mouths, though my son and his wife work in Shijiazhuang and send some money home. I don't have my own tractor, so I hire Old Zhang from the village for rotary tillage — 50 yuan per mu.

My stevia went in the ground in late March. Those seedlings are expensive, 600 yuan per mu, but they grow fast and I can harvest by late June. For the 4 mu, I already put down 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu before planting. I'll irrigate three times from the well and spray insecticide three times for the aphids. My wife and I do most of the work, but we hired one person for a day to help with transplanting.

Now for cotton, my main crop, about 12 mu. I'll plant around April 12th, when the soil is warm enough. I buy improved cotton seeds from the shop — about 2 jin per mu, around 37 yuan. I always use plastic film, another 5 yuan per mu, otherwise the cold wind kills the seedlings.

For fertilizer, I don't have much cash after paying 3,600 yuan land rent. My neighbor Wang uses two bags of compound fertilizer per mu, but he's younger and has more money. Last year I didn't put much on the cotton and still got 350 kg per mu. This year I'll put about 60 jin of compound fertilizer per mu before planting — one bag for every two mu, costs about 45 yuan per mu. Then at flowering, if the plants look yellow, I'll topdress with half a bag of urea per mu. I don't want to waste money, but I also don't want a bad year — losing yield hurts more than saving a few yuan.

Irrigation is twice from the well, border irrigation, about 75 yuan per mu for the season. Water is metered and costly, so I can't do more. I spray insecticide four times for the bollworm and other pests — about 25 yuan per mu. I don't use herbicide; the plastic film keeps most weeds down, and we pull the rest by hand.

Cotton harvest is the hard part. It's all hand-picking, takes about 35–40 days for the 12 mu. My wife helps, and my son might come back for a few days. I also need to do topping and pruning — another 20 days or so. Stevia harvest is easier, about 12 days for the 4 mu.

I expect about 320 kg of seed cotton per mu this year. Last year was 350, but I'm getting older and the weather has been strange. Stevia should give 500 kg per mu like always, sold at 6 yuan per kg. After costs and the 2,400 yuan cotton subsidy, I should have enough to get by and maybe fix the roof this winter.
